AI feedback type: Short on-demand hints, no full solutions
Outcome measures: Immediate test score; exercises completed; questionnaire
Key findings: AI-hint group scored higher on immediate test (78 vs 69/100); similar exercise completion; 17/24 said hints helped them continue when stuck.
Limitations: Single site; small sample; no retention test; blind marking not reported; hint sometimes mismatched the actual error (frequency not reported).

AI feedback type: Explanation + one suggested next step from submitted code
Key findings: Students valued code-specific explanations; generic responses less useful for multiple interacting errors; students checked high-impact suggestions with lecturers or peers.
Limitations: No comparison group; no performance measure; coding process briefly described; sites not compared.

AI feedback type: Automated feedback on failed test cases with LLM explanation
Outcome measures: Exercise pass rate; dropout; help-forum posts
Key findings: Higher first-attempt pass rate in AI-feedback arm (+7 percentage points); fewer forum posts; no difference in course dropout.
Limitations: Short duration; outcome limited to exercise pass rate; learner background not reported; no retention measure.
